hospital-clinic.position: Sell speed-to-triage, not lab replacement — the hospital buyer's problem is minutes-to-decision, and that is exactly what a POC rapid test solves.
reasoning: Emergency departments triage chest pain and fever faster with POC cardiac and infectious markers.
Position the test as reducing central-lab load and enabling immediate treatment decisions.
Never claim it replaces the lab — high-sensitivity confirmatory testing is the standard.

pharmacy-retail.position: In retail, shelf presence and packaging sell the product, not the spec sheet — optimize for the end consumer, not the clinician.
reasoning: hCG/LH are impulse and repeat-purchase products; clear, appealing retail packaging wins.
Simple visual readout and private-label branding are the levers.
Keep the consumer messaging simple — the buyer is not a lab tech.

workplace-drug.position: Sell the tamper-evident cup and the confirmatory workflow, not just a strip — that is the defensible, higher-margin product.
reasoning: Adulteration checks (pH, specific gravity, oxidants) protect the integrity of the sample.
A documented presumptive-to-confirmatory workflow is what makes a program legally defensible.
Bulk and panel pricing win workplace programs.

blood-bank-antenatal.position: In blood-bank and antenatal screening, documentation and the confirmation pathway are as important as the device itself.
reasoning: HBsAg/HCV/HIV/syphilis screens must map to a documented confirmation algorithm.
Combo cassettes reduce hands-on steps in high-throughput settings.
Supply CE/ISO certificates, validation data and COA up front — buyers in this segment demand it.

public-health.position: Field programs buy documentation, stability and bulk supply — the test's clinical spec matters less than its logistics reliability.
reasoning: Room-temperature-stable, instrument-free kits survive remote and tropical distribution.
NGO and tender buyers need full documentation (certificates, validation, COA) before bidding.
Bulk supply with consistent lot-to-lot quality is the winning pitch.
